capabilities: Expand multi-letter custom shorthands into LaTeX snippets
Auto-close $ signs, braces and brackets and move the cursor between them
Replace a/b expressions with \frac{}{} on space
Insert align and matrix blocks with hotkeys and auto next-line syntax
Auto-enlarge brackets containing \sum, \int or \frac with \left and \right
extras: The README states the plugin is no longer maintained and recommends Latex Suite as a successor; it also warns bugs may be present since it was the author's first plugin and depends on an early-alpha Obsidian API.
problem: Typing LaTeX math in Obsidian requires verbose syntax like \frac{}{} and \begin{align*}, plus manually paired $ and bracket symbols, which slows down writing.

relations.evidence: There is now a more powerful and well maintained Latex writing plugin that I highly recommend : Latex Suite

summary: LaTeX math typing helper that expands custom shorthands and auto-closes symbols, brackets, fractions, align and matrix blocks while you type.
